fact: The 2026 catalogue of Ivorian standards states that CODINORM is the concessionaire for national standardisation and certification under a convention of 6 January 1995 renewed on 6 September 2016, under law 2013-866 and decree 2014-460 creating the Comité Ivoirien de Normalisation; it lists no standard on information technology or data.
title: Catalogue des normes ivoiriennes 2026
